items.stem: 짝지어진 단어의 관계가 나머지와 다른 것은?
items.explain: ④는 반의어(심각한 – 사소한), 나머지는 유의어.

items.stem: 다음 대화의 빈칸 ⓐ~ⓓ 중 어느 곳에도 들어갈 수 없는 표현은?
items.box:
B: Wait! ⓐ______ throw that pen in the bin.
G: Why not? It's plastic.
B: ⓑ______ pens can't be recycled. It's not all plastic.
G: Oh, okay. Thanks.

G: I can't finish this sandwich.
B: ⓒ______? Wasting food is bad for the Earth.
G: Why?
B: Food waste makes greenhouse gases.
G: Oh, I get it. ⓓ______ bring less food next time.
items.explain: ⓐ Don't ⓑ I heard that ⓒ You know what ⓓ I'll. Thanks for 는 들어갈 자리가 없다.

items.stem: 아래 (A)~(C)를 대화의 흐름에 맞게 순서대로 배열한 것은?
items.box:
B: Judy, what's your dream job?
(A) That sounds right for you. Good luck!
(B) I want to be a photographer.
(C) Thanks. What do you want to be, Minjun?
B: I want to be a chef.
G: Great. I hope you become a famous chef.
items.explain: 꿈의 직업 답(B) → 격려(A) → 고맙다며 되묻기(C).

items.box:
Liam: I'm thinking about future jobs.
Ms. Han: Good. It's important (A)[start / to start] planning early.
Liam: It's not easy (B)[for / of] me to choose my future job.
Ms. Han: First, focus on your interests and hobbies.
Liam: I'm interested in coding these days, but I'm not good at it.
Ms. Han: That's okay.
Liam: And I don't have any special hobbies.
Ms. Han: What about (C)[learn / learning] something?
Liam: I'd like to learn the guitar.
Ms. Han: That sounds great.
Liam: Hmm.... I think my interests are all over the place. Is that okay?
Ms. Han: Sure! Keep exploring different things, (D)[and / or] you'll find your dream job.

items.stem: (A)~(D)에 들어갈 어법에 맞는 표현으로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.explain: 가주어 It + 진주어 to부정사 / easy 는 for + 목적격 / What about + 동명사 / 명령문, and(그러면).

items.stem: 위 대화를 읽고 답할 수 없는 것은?
choices: What is Liam interested in these days?
What would Liam like to learn?
How long has Liam learned coding?
What does Ms. Han tell Liam to focus on first?
items.explain: 코딩을 배운 기간은 나오지 않는다.

items.stem: 다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어 중 위 대화에서 찾을 수 없는 것은?
choices: a way to get to a place or goal
to travel to or around an area in order to learn about it
an activity that you do for pleasure in your free time
to decide what you want from two or more things
the feeling of wanting to know or learn about something
items.explain: ① path — 대화에 없다. ② explore(exploring) ③ hobby(hobbies) ④ choose ⑤ interest(s).

items.stem: 다음 두 문장을 「명령문, and」를 이용해 주어진 해석에 맞고 어법상 바르게 영작한 것은?
items.box:
열심히 연습해라, 그러면 너의 실력이 향상될 것이다.
• Practice hard.  • Your skills will improve.
choices: Practice hard, and your skills will improve.
Practice hard, or your skills will improve.
Practicing hard, and your skills will improve.
If you practice hard, and your skills will improve.
Practice hard, and your skills improve will.
items.explain: '그러면'은 and. ② or(그렇지 않으면) ③ 동사원형으로 시작해야 한다 ④ If 절 뒤에 and 를 쓰지 않는다 ⑤ 어순.
items.source: 통합본 L5 문법 2 · 학습지 Grammar Point B

items.box:
Date & Time: November 27, 11:30 a.m.
Last night, some healthy corals in the sea (A)<u>laid</u> eggs during the full moon. This morning, hundreds of baby corals (B)<u>were born</u> from the eggs like magic. They were cute and amazing. I hope this miracle (C)<u>will happen</u> to other sick corals, too. (D)<u>Although</u> it took time (E)<u>to heal</u> the sick corals and grow healthy ones, it was worth the hard work.

items.stem: 윗글의 (A)~(E)에 대한 설명으로 옳지 않은 것은?
choices: (C): hope의 목적어인 that절 안에서 미래를 나타낸다.
(D): '~ 때문에'라는 뜻의 접속사로 because와 바꿔 쓸 수 있다.
items.explain: Although 는 '비록 ~이지만'(양보). though, even though 로 바꿔 쓴다.

items.stem: 윗글의 ones가 대신하는 말로 가장 알맞은 것은?
items.explain: healthy ones = healthy corals. 앞의 명사를 반복하지 않으려고 쓴 대명사.

items.stem: 윗글에 대한 설명으로 옳은 것의 개수는?
items.box:
• during 뒤에는 명사(구)가 온다.
• Last night이 있으므로 laid 대신 have laid를 써도 된다.
• hundreds of는 '수백의'라는 뜻이다.
• amazing은 산호들이 스스로 놀랐다는 뜻이다.
• miracle은 'something wonderful that seems impossible'로 풀이할 수 있다.
• happen은 'to take place'와 같은 뜻이다.
• Although는 Though나 Even though로 바꿔 쓸 수 있다.
• worth는 'good or useful enough for something'으로 풀이할 수 있다.
items.explain: 옳은 것 6개. 과거의 특정 시점(Last night)에는 현재완료를 쓰지 않는다(✗), amazing 은 '(남을) 놀라게 하는'(✗).
items.source: 학습지 p109 필기 · L6 Crossword 영영풀이

items.box:
Date & Time: November 7, 9:40 p.m.
For the last two weeks, my team has put (가)<u>ointment</u> on sick corals.
(A) When they are ready, we'll plant them onto the corals in the sea.
(B) We also took some healthy baby corals from the sea and put them in tanks of seawater.
(C) This food helps baby corals grow stronger.
(D) We feed them clam parts and seaweed smoothies.
(E) Our goal is to grow many healthy corals.
I look forward to seeing the results!

items.stem: 윗글의 흐름에 맞게 (A)~(E)를 순서대로 배열할 때, ★에 들어갈 것으로 가장 알맞은 것은?
items.explain: (B) 아기 산호를 수조에 → (D) 먹이를 준다 → (C) This food 가 자라게 돕는다 → (A) 준비되면 심는다 → (E) 목표. ★은 (C).

items.stem: 윗글의 (가)ointment의 영영풀이로 가장 적절한 것은?
choices: a soft cream used on the skin to treat a medical problem
a thick, blended drink made from fruit, often mixed with juice, milk, yogurt, or ice
a container for holding liquid or gas
a plant that grows in the sea
a type of sea animal with a shell in two parts and a soft body that can be eaten
items.explain: ② smoothie ③ tank ④ seaweed ⑤ clam.

items.stem: 다음 문장의 빈칸에 of가 들어가는 것은?
choices: It is necessary ______ us to prepare for the test.
It is fun ______ them to play table tennis.
It was rude ______ the boy to shout in class.
It is scary ______ me to travel by plane.
It is impossible ______ her to walk such a long way.
items.explain: rude 처럼 사람의 성격·태도를 나타내는 형용사 뒤에는 of + 목적격.
items.source: 통합본 L5 문법 B · 학습지 Grammar Point A

items.stem: 밑줄 친 현재완료의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
choices: Dan <u>has never been</u> to Canada before.
My mom <u>has used</u> this car for more than ten years.
She <u>has just moved</u> to this town.
items.explain: <보기>는 결과 용법(잃어버려서 지금 없다). ① 경험 ② 계속 ③ 결과 ④ 완료 ⑤ 경험.
items.source: 통합본 L6 문법 B · 학습지 Grammar Point A

items.box:
Everyday Actions for a Better Earth
For years, I (   ) wasted water. It's not good (   ) the Earth. From now (   ), I will practice small actions (   ) my everyday life. First, I will use a cup when I brush my teeth. Second, I will take shorter showers. Although I didn't care much before, I will be kinder (   ) the Earth from now on.

items.stem: 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 수 없는 것은?
items.explain: have wasted(계속) / good for / from now on / in my everyday life / kinder to.

items.stem: 윗글의 글쓴이가 하기로 한 일이 아닌 것은?
items.explain: 손수건 이야기는 글에 없다(Listen & Speak A-3 의 내용).

items.stem: 다음 우리말을 주어진 단어를 모두 한 번씩 사용해 영작할 때, 일곱 번째에 오는 단어는?
items.box:
여러분이 다양한 활동을 경험하는 것은 매우 중요하다.
→ (activities, different, experience, for, important, is, it, to, very, you)
(*단, 대소문자는 구분하지 않음.)
items.explain: It is very important for you to experience different activities. 일곱 번째는 to.

items.stem: 양보의 의미를 살려 어법상 바르게 변형한 것은?
choices:
Although it was hot, they wore a jacket.
→ Despite the hot weather, they wore a jacket.

Although he was sick, he went to the party.
→ Despite he was sick, he went to the party.

Although the noise was loud, I kept studying.
→ In spite of the noise was loud, I kept studying.

I went out though it was raining hard.
→ I went out despite of the rain.

Although she has a busy schedule, she helped me.
→ Although her busy schedule, she helped me.
items.explain: despite / in spite of 뒤에는 명사(구), although 뒤에는 절. ④ despite of ✗.
items.source: 통합본 L6 문법 10·12·14 · 학습지 Grammar Point B

items.box:
A Journey to Find My Dream
Some of you have a dream job in mind, but others do not. It is not easy for you to find a future job. But we all need to answer the question, “What do you want to be in the future?” Think about the following questions, and you will find a path to your future job.
What Do I Have to Do Now?
First, focus on your school subjects now. They give you the basic skills for your future. These skills help you ⓐ<u>make</u> good choices. Second, gather information about jobs ⓑ<u>that</u> interest you. You can watch videos and movies, or read books about <u>them</u>. This way, you can learn about real work in those jobs. Finally, keep ⓒ<u>trying</u> new things! Your interests can change often. (A)<u>여러분이 다양한 활동을 경험하는 것은 매우 중요하다.</u> Our world keeps ⓓ<u>changing</u>, and jobs will also change. Keep exploring, ⓔ<u>or</u> you'll find your dream job soon.

items.stem: 밑줄 친 (A)를 바르게 영작한 문장은?
choices: It is very important for you to experience different activities.
It is very important of you to experience different activities.
It is very important for you experiencing different activities.
This is very important for you to experience different activities.
It is very important for your to experience different activities.
items.explain: 가주어 It + important + for 목적격 + to부정사.

items.stem: 윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?
items.explain: '계속 탐구하라, 그러면 찾을 것이다' → and. ⓐ help + 목적어 + 동사원형 ⓑ 주격 관계대명사 ⓒⓓ keep + 동명사.

items.stem: 윗글의 밑줄 친 them이 가리키는 것으로 가장 알맞은 것은?
items.explain: 관심 있는 직업에 관한 영상·책.

items.stem: 윗글을 읽고 답할 수 없는 것은?
choices: What should you focus on first?
What do school subjects give you?
How can you gather information about jobs?
Which school subject is the most important?
Why should you keep trying new things?
items.explain: 가장 중요한 과목은 나오지 않는다.

items.box:
Date & Time: September 15, 5:30 p.m.
It's a sad day for me. This morning, I ⓐ<u>went</u> scuba diving at my favorite spot in the sea. It was a place ⓑ<u>that was full of</u> beautiful and colorful corals. But today, I saw that corals ⓒ<u>was getting</u> sick. I was shocked. Because of the warm seawater, corals ⓓ<u>have turned</u> white. Different types of waste have harmed the corals, too. Now the spot ⓔ<u>have lost</u> its colors and beauty. I'm really worried.
Date & Time: October 2, 10:00 a.m.
I have thought about (A)<u>how to help</u> corals. My plan is to form a team of divers. My team can go underwater and take   (가)   of the sick corals. Many corals get sick because they don't get good   (가)   in time. I'm sure that other divers are worried about this, too. I'm going to post a message online to look for volunteer divers.

items.stem: 윗글의 빈칸 (가)에 공통으로 들어갈 단어가 아래 ①~⑤의 빈칸에 사용되었을 때, 문맥상 가장 적절한 것은?
choices: The nurse gave the patient good (     ).
He (     ) the ball to me yesterday.
I (     ) my bike to school every day.
We had a (     ) day at the beach.
items.explain: (가) care(take care of / good care). 간호사가 환자를 잘 돌보았다.
items.source: L6 본문 1·2단락 · 학습지 p108 필기(care 의 뜻)

items.stem: 밑줄 친 (A)how to help와 바꿔 쓸 수 있는 것은?
items.explain: 의문사 + to부정사 = 의문사 + 주어 + should + 동사원형.

items.stem: 윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 어법상 옳은 것의 개수는?
items.explain: ⓐⓑⓓ 옳다. ⓒ corals 복수 → were getting, ⓔ the spot 단수 → has lost.

items.stem: 다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어 중 윗글에서 찾을 수 없는 것은?
choices: unhappy because you think something bad might happen
to have a bad effect on something
to begin to exist or to make something begin to exist
to process waste so that it can be used again
someone who does something without being paid or forced to do it
items.explain: ① worried ② harm(harmed) ③ form ④ recycle — 글에 없다 ⑤ volunteer.

items.stem: 다음 안내문의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

box.title: Divers Wanted
lines: We want team members to help sick corals.
• Grow healthy baby corals in tanks of seawater
Together, we can make the ocean healthy again!
Please send me a message if you are interested!

choices: The team is looking for members to help sick corals.
Members will clean up the ocean.
Members will put ointment on sick corals.
Baby corals will be grown in the open sea.
People who are interested should send a message.
items.explain: 아기 산호는 바닷물 수조(tanks of seawater)에서 키운다.

items.stem: 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
items.box:
It is difficult for me to learn a new language.
It was polite of he to hold the door for the next person.
Save your money, and you can buy what you want.
Hurrying up, or you will be late for school.
She has been in a hospital since last Monday.
I have bought a train ticket last night.
Though my grandma is 80 years old, she is very healthy.
In spite of catching a bad cold, she went to school.
items.explain: 옳은 것: 1·3·5·7·8. of him / Hurry up, or / bought (last night 과거).
items.source: 통합본 L5·L6 문법 · 학습지 Grammar Point
